bugFindings.title: Markdown links render as inert <button> with no href/handler
bugFindings.description: Streamdown (mode="static", controls=false) renders both the internal cross-reference link '[Privacy Policy](/privacy)' (Sec.1, Sec.9.1) and the 'mailto:support@mira.day' links (Sec.1, 3.2, 5.2, 12.2, 14.5) as <button type="button" data-streamdown="link"> elements with no href attribute. Verified by DOM query: href=null on all 8 occurrences, and by direct click on the Sec.1 'Privacy Policy' button — no navigation occurred (URL unchanged), no console errors/warnings logged. Users cannot click through to the Privacy Policy or open their mail client to email support@mira.day from this static legal page.
reproduction: Click the 'Privacy Policy' text in section 1 ('These Terms should be read together with our Privacy Policy...')
Observe: no navigation to /privacy, no visual feedback
bugFindings.impact: Legal/compliance page cross-references and support contact are unusable by real users (keyboard and mouse) — same defect pattern expected on /privacy given identical LegalContent/Streamdown wiring.
bugFindings.affectedComponent: apps/mira-work/app/(legal)/legal-content.tsx (Streamdown controls={false} config, or missing custom `a` component override)

summary.notes: Smoke-scope baseline. Page renders correctly (all 16 headings present, matches source content 1:1, no crash/500). One functional defect found: markdown-rendered links (Privacy Policy cross-ref + mailto support links) are non-interactive buttons with no href — see bugFindings.
